flavor.phonemic_palette: Iberian backbone (Latinate vowels over a Celtic substrate; hard c/k; -o/-a/-briga/-ica endings; clusters br/gr/nt) with a Punic overlay (the construct chain Qart-/Mahoz-/Beth-, feminine -t, the trade register); theophoric on the Iberian morphs (Caiandos-, Orlanno-) with Punic variants (Arganz-, Tulrish-).
flavor.phenotype_notes: Synthesis of Carthaginian + Iberian per setting-lore §5.3 (blend the listed features; exclude the inverse).

magic_attitude.notes: Carthaginian + Iberian register; deity-morphs in name_bank 'tartessan'.

religion_hooks.alignment_lens: Resolved per the culture's chosen alignment (setting-lore §4.2): Lawful venerates the 12 Lawful powers and names the 13 as demons; Chaotic venerates the 13 and names the 12 as tyrant-gods; Neutral venerates this culture's ancestral saints, invoking the great gods only situationally.

flavor_text.one_line: Tartessan — tolerant mercantile republic of the scrubland; wealth, cunning.
flavor_text.one_paragraph: The Tartessan (Carthaginian + Iberian) are a defensive mercantile republic people seeded in scrubland, hills. They prize wealth, cunning, freedom, lean toward the mercantile sphere, and field marines, light_infantry, light_cavalry. Outsiders are met as tolerant; their patrons touch trade, sea, night.
